brief: NLB Group runs the only full dual-listed IR operation in Slovenian banking, and its disclosure landscape is unusually well-structured: a single IR hub at nlbgroup.com mirrored in Slovenian (/si-sl/vlagatelji), feeding a document library that spans 2013-2026 with annual reports, quarterly interim reports, results presentations, Pillar 3 disclosures, factsheets, Excel key-financials and XBRL under predictable /content/dam/... paths. Around that core sit investor news, a financial calendar, webcast events, an Investor Day microsite, agency rating reports, an analyst coverage/consensus layer, and a live Addiko takeover disclosure page - together the richest source of digital/IT investment and SEE-expansion commentary available for any Slovenian bank. Two authoritative venues sit outside the issuer's own site and remain only partially resolved: SEOnet at the Ljubljana Stock Exchange (statutory Slovenian regulated-information storage, ASP.NET and form-driven) and the London RNS stream for the BNY Mellon GDR line (bot-defended, best reached today via the Investegate mirror). The main collection frictions are the absence of any RSS feed, audio-only earnings Q&A, and legacy pre-2023 Slovenian PDFs still living under nlb.si rather than nlbgroup.com.
